content.title: Lubricant Oil Degradation, Condition Monitoring, and Service Life Estimation: A Review
content.abstract: ABSTRACT Lubricant oil is often changed on fixed time schedules, even though its real condition depends on load, temperature, and contamination, so good oil is discarded in some cases and degraded oil stays in service in others, which adds cost and waste and raises the risk of gearbox and hydraulic system failures. Degradation, monitoring, and life prediction are usually reviewed separately, so the links between them remain unclear.
